text:
sam: Heads-up: seeing a spike in spot interruptions in us-west1 starting ~22:10 — interruption_rate up ~25% across gpu-pool-mix, autoscaler retried a bunch and we had backlog on inference-queue. Anyone else seeing this? @oncall

maria: yep, got the alert. capacity_signal for west1-b dropped before interruptions. dashboard link in DM (grafana panel).

jin: on it. can you paste the prom query for interruption_rate you used?

sam: ```
sum(rate(spot_interruptions_total[5m])) by (zone) / sum(gpu_capacity_total) by (zone) * 100
```
Observed last 10m: west1-b ~27%, west1-c ~4%.

ops-qa: we saw a short network maintenance in west1-c at 22:05 but it was infra-net only — nothing scheduled for GPU pools.

maria: looks like cloud-side spot churn. proposal: if interruption_rate > 10% sustained for 5m, trigger autoscaler fallback to reserved pool and route new requests away from affected zones. Also pre-warm +1 instance per 50 pending shards.

jin: +1. also change alert smoothing — current 1m eval causes flapping. new rule: interruption_rate > 10% for 3m AND drop_in_capacity_signal > 15% (5m window). Makes it less noisy.

infra-alerts: PagerDuty INC-7892 created (trigger: spot_interruptions, assigned: sam, escalation: jin).

sam: :thumbsup: I'll open INFRA-1234 for the ops changes and a small PR for the alert rule. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/456

maria: adding runbook note: when spots degrade, enable mixed-capacity-fallback (reserved + cheaper region), and notify CS if SLO impact > 5%.

jin: I'll add a dashboard panel comparing SLO_error_budget_consumed vs spot_interruptions_total and link it in the PR. That should help correlate interruptions -> SLO hit.

ops-qa: after the fallback kicked in we saw tail latency return to baseline in ~90s for most flows. Queue drained after scaling reserved pool up by 2.

sam: closing loop — INFRA-1234 created, PR opened, monitoring on. Will watch for 24h and escalate if repeat. Thanks all.
thread_root_summary: Discussion about spike in spot interruptions in us-west1, proposed alert smoothing and autoscaler fallback to reserved pool, created incident INC-7892 and ticket INFRA-1234, PR opened to update alert rules and dashboards.
